Rae (AE): SpruceBank wants a short POC: streaming invoice ingest + tool calls -> strict JSON schema. Need a 10m runbook, Node snippet, auth pattern, and rough cost for ~1M tokens/mo.
Tao (SE): I'll own the runbook. @Marta can you paste a minimal Node example (stream + tool call) and recommended defaults?
Marta (SDK): Minimal SSE example below. Use SSE for simple reconnects; websocket only if client needs bi-directional control.
Marta (SDK): ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const s = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', mode: 'sse' })
s.on('message', m => { try { console.log(JSON.parse(m)) } catch(e) {} })
// tool call envelope: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"invoice_parser","input":{"text":"..."}}
```
Marta (SDK): Defaults: batch_size=8, token_window=512. For low latency use batch_size=1 + KV cache. For sustained load recommend reserved capacity.
Ibrahim (Security): Spruce requires SAML + EU KMS for finance data. For presales ok to use ephemeral creds and scoped logs; legal sign-off before PHI. We'll provide a short security appendix.
Clara (Solutions): Ballpark: hosted ~ $650/mo for ~1M tokens. Reserved cluster add-on ~$7k/mo for steady throughput. I'll add a one-slide tradeoffs summary.
Rae (AE): Can we get a staging URL and ephemeral creds by Monday?
DeployBot: Deployed spruce-poc-staging at https://staging.spruce.redwood. Ephemeral creds sent to rae@spruce.com (24h).
Tao (SE): Runbook draft uploaded to internal runbooks with validation harness + adapter snippet.
Marta (SDK): Uploaded adapter that maps model output to schema keys; include strict JSON schema in the demo.
Ibrahim (Security): Security appendix uploaded.
Rae (AE): Thanks team — please thumbs-up when final so I can share with customer before kickoff. :rocket:
